items.title: One threat actor responsible for 83% of recent Ivanti RCE attacks
items.description: Threat intelligence observations show that a single threat actor is responsible for most of the active exploitation of two critical vulnerabilities in Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM), tracked as CVE-2026-21962 and CVE-2026-24061. [...]

items.title: Snail mail letters target Trezor and Ledger users in crypto-theft attacks
items.description: Threat actors are sending physical letters pretending to be from Trezor and Ledger, makers of cryptocurrency hardware wallets, to trick users into submitting recovery phrases in crypto theft attacks. [...]

items.title: New Clickfix Exploit Tricks Users into Changing DNS Settings for Malware Installation
items.description: A new evolution in the ClickFix social engineering campaign, which now employs a custom DNS hijacking technique to deliver malware. This attack method tricks users into executing malicious commands that utilize DNS lookups to fetch the next stage of the infection, allowing attackers to bypass traditional detection methods and blend in with normal network traffic. items.title: Zscaler-SquareX Deal Boosts Zero Trust, Secure Browsing Capabilities
items.description: Zscaler's acquisition of SquareX comes as competitors like CrowdStrike and Palo Alto Networks are also investing in secure browser technologies.
